function.name: route_caller
function.description: Decide where to send the caller. Call this as soon as you understand why they are calling. Returns an action: transfer, callback, clarify or emergency, with an instruction to follow.

reason.description: Why the caller is calling, in their own words (one sentence). Include any urgent symptoms they mentioned.

department.description: Your best guess of the department, only if you are confident.

messages.content: The routing service failed. Apologise briefly and offer to take a callback request.
